draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.26, the 59th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 9th of 37 at CB. He went 44th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Maurice Canady. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (92nd percentile). Testing concerns: three-cone (3rd percentile). College production: 1 passes defended in 2020, 29th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2024. 33 career games and 3 starts over 4 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2021. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (2nd percentile). Played 2 of 17 games in 2024.
